title: monolithic — backbreaking

translations.translation: 单片电路, 单块集成电路

phrases.translation: n. 整体结构；单片结构；独石结构

sentences.sentence: This monolithic environment for an application eliminated any concern about which clock to use -- because there was only one clock.
sentences.translation: 对于一个应用程序的这个单块集成电路环境消除了使用哪个时钟的问题 —— 因为只有一个时钟。

sentences.sentence: The solutions that were developed for that were usually large monolithic programs containing the business-level logic hardcoded in the modules.
sentences.translation: 为此开发的解决方案通常是大型单片电路程序，在一些模块中包含硬编码的业务层面逻辑。

sentences.sentence: We see human civilizations begin throughout both North and South America with different levels of complexity, technology and cohesiveness.
sentences.translation: 我们看到北美洲和南美洲的人类文明在复杂性、技术力和凝聚力上以不同的水平展开。

sentences.sentence: Another function is to maintain cohesiveness by regulating the willingness of various stakeholders to serve the organization, and by maintaining the stability of authority.
sentences.translation: 而另一项职能则是通过调节不同利益相关者为组织服务的愿望，以及维护权威的稳定性来保持凝聚力。

sentences.sentence: Theo had been behaving peculiarly.
sentences.translation: 西奥的举止一直很古怪。

phrases.translation: 汤姆·克鲁斯（美国著名影星）

sentences.sentence: A black and white police car cruised past.
sentences.translation: 一辆黑白相间的警车平稳驶过。

sentences.sentence: The Navy will use the machine principally for oceanographic modeling and weather forecasting.
sentences.translation: 海军将主要将该计算机用于海洋图像建模和天气预报。

phrases.translation: n. 恶性螺旋形上升；[经]恶性通货膨胀螺旋

sentences.translation: 一桩凶残的谋杀案

sentences.sentence: a vicious killer
sentences.translation: 凶狠的杀手

sentences.sentence: Keep away from that dog, he can be vicious.
sentences.translation: 离那只狗远点，它有时很凶猛。

sentences.translation: 我们到甲板上去吧。

phrases.translation: 拥挤收费；堵车费；高峰期行车收费

sentences.sentence: The problems of traffic congestion will not disappear in a hurry.
sentences.translation: 交通堵塞问题不会很快消失。

sentences.sentence: In such circumstances, governments must do all they can to create and engender trust among its nation’s constituents and institutions.
sentences.translation: 在这种情况下，政府必须尽其所能在它的国家选民和公共机构之间创造和产生信任。

sentences.sentence: Retrospectives on the process and working practices regularly capture the lessons learned by the project and engender a culture of continuous process improvement within the project.
sentences.translation: 对过程和工作实践的回顾有规律地捕捉从项目中得到的经验，并在项目中造成一个持续的过程改进的文化。

sentences.sentence: ...the difficulties facing women in the workplace.
sentences.translation: …妇女在工作场所中面临的困难。

translations.translation: 一丝不苟的, 缜密的

sentences.sentence: He kept meticulous accounts.
sentences.translation: 他的账记得一丝不苟。

sentences.sentence: Their planning and preparation were meticulous.
sentences.translation: 他们的计划和准备工作都很周密。

sentences.sentence: He cleaned the tools with meticulous care.
sentences.translation: 他十分认真地清洁了工具。

sentences.sentence: The book describes his journey in meticulous detail.
sentences.translation: 这本书很详细地描述了他的旅程。

sentences.sentence: He spoke in fluent Italian.
sentences.translation: 他用流利的意大利语讲话。

sentences.sentence: So why then do we reject the impermanence of the ever-changing universe when it comes to our own lives?
sentences.translation: 所以，为什么我们要拒绝这千变万化的宇宙中的无常，当它来到我们身边时？

sentences.sentence: During difficult times, be committed to resolving problems, but also lighten up and ride the waves of impermanence.
sentences.translation: 身处困境时，既要全神贯注地解决问题，也要身心放松，驾驭无常的世事。

translations.translation: 不能穿过的, 不可理喻的

sentences.sentence: The trees formed a dark and impenetrable barrier.
sentences.translation: 这些树形成了一道无法通过的黑暗屏障。

sentences.sentence: the impenetrable blackness of the night
sentences.translation: 夜晚伸手不见五指的黑

sentences.sentence: You may be doing what could just as easily be done by someone else, which means you’re highly expendable. You may be playing follow the follower.
sentences.translation: 你可能在做一些其他也能轻易完成的事，那可能意味着你是完全可牺牲的，你可能是追随追随者的人。

sentences.sentence: In the same way our bodies allocate blood flow away from expendable extremities in favour of vital organs during a crisis, companies must make sure their best markets and consumers are protected.
sentences.translation: 就像我们的身体在危急时刻，把血液从可以牺牲的四肢调配给致命器官的方式一样，公司必须确保其最好的市场和顾客受到保护。

translations.translation: 不可否认的, 无可辩驳的

sentences.sentence: undeniable proof
sentences.translation: 确证

phrases.translation: 征服者威廉（英国国王威廉一世，等于William I）

sentences.sentence: The people of an oppressed country obey their conquerors because they want to go on living.
sentences.translation: 一个被压迫国家的人民顺从他们的征服者，是因为他们想活下去。

sentences.sentence: The government had also incurred huge debts.
sentences.translation: 政府也已承受了大笔债务。

sentences.sentence: Just as our exchanges with the local grocer free us from backbreaking farm work, so do imports from around the world move us even more toward the very economic specialization that enriches us.
sentences.translation: 就好像我们与当地的杂货店交易，我们就不用非常辛苦地从事农业劳动，来自全世界的进口品让我们更快地走向经济专业化，使我们富裕。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 337 单元

monolithic
音标：英 /mɒnə'lɪθɪk/  美 /,mɑnə'lɪθɪk/
n. 单片电路, 单块集成电路
短语：monolithic integrated circuit — n. 单片硅积体电路
短语：monolithic processor — 单片处理机
短语：monolithic structure — n. 整体结构；单片结构；独石结构
短语：monolithic integration — 单片集成电路
例句：This monolithic environment for an application eliminated any concern about which clock to use -- because there was only one clock.
对于一个应用程序的这个单块集成电路环境消除了使用哪个时钟的问题 —— 因为只有一个时钟。
例句：The solutions that were developed for that were usually large monolithic programs containing the business-level logic hardcoded in the modules.
为此开发的解决方案通常是大型单片电路程序，在一些模块中包含硬编码的业务层面逻辑。

cohesiveness
音标：英 /kəu'hi:sivnis/  美 /ko'hisɪvnɪs/
n. 粘合, 凝聚性
例句：We see human civilizations begin throughout both North and South America with different levels of complexity, technology and cohesiveness.
我们看到北美洲和南美洲的人类文明在复杂性、技术力和凝聚力上以不同的水平展开。
例句：Another function is to maintain cohesiveness by regulating the willingness of various stakeholders to serve the organization, and by maintaining the stability of authority.
而另一项职能则是通过调节不同利益相关者为组织服务的愿望，以及维护权威的稳定性来保持凝聚力。

peculiarly
音标：英 /pɪ'kjuːlɪəlɪ/  美 /pɪ'kjʊljɚli/
adv. 古怪地,  特有地
例句：Theo had been behaving peculiarly.
西奥的举止一直很古怪。

cruise
音标：英 /kruːz/  美 /krʊz/
vi&n. 巡游, 漫游
短语：tom cruise — 汤姆·克鲁斯（美国著名影星）
短语：cruise missile — n. 巡航导弹
短语：cruise ship — 游轮，游艇
短语：cruise control — 恒速操纵器
例句：A black and white police car cruised past.
一辆黑白相间的警车平稳驶过。

oceanographic
音标：美 /,əuʃiənəu'ɡræfik/
adj. 海洋学的
例句：The Navy will use the machine principally for oceanographic modeling and weather forecasting.
海军将主要将该计算机用于海洋图像建模和天气预报。

vicious
音标：英 /'vɪʃəs/  美 /'vɪʃəs/
adj. 恶毒的，凶残的
短语：vicious circle — 恶性循环；循环论证法
短语：vicious cycle — 恶性循环
短语：vicious spiral — n. 恶性螺旋形上升；[经]恶性通货膨胀螺旋
例句：a vicious murder
一桩凶残的谋杀案
例句：a vicious killer
凶狠的杀手
例句：Keep away from that dog, he can be vicious.
离那只狗远点，它有时很凶猛。

turnip
音标：英 /'tɜːnɪp/  美 /'tɝnɪp/
n. [植]芜箐(甘蓝)

deck
音标：英 /dek/  美 /dɛk/
n. 甲板, 舰板
短语：double deck — n. 楼中楼；双层甲板
短语：bridge deck — 桥面板；船桥甲板
短语：on the deck — [俚]一文不名，贫困
短语：on deck — 在甲板上；准备就绪的；下一个将轮到的
短语：steel deck — 钢板层；钢面板；钢甲板
短语：deck with — 以...装饰
短语：upper deck — 上层甲板
短语：deck of cards — n. 一幅牌，扑克牌
短语：flight deck — 飞行甲板；驾驶舱
短语：deck machinery — 甲板机械；舱面机械
短语：main deck — 主甲板；正甲板
短语：observation deck — 观测甲板；了望甲板
短语：deck hand — 甲板水手
短语：deck plate — 台面板；甲板板
短语：tape deck — n. 录放音座（等于deck）；磁带放送机（等于tape player）
短语：deck structure — 舱面建筑；甲板结构；上承结构；舱面结构
短语：poop deck — 船尾楼甲板
短语：top deck — 甲板；上甲板；坞墙顶甲板
短语：deck chair — 折叠式躺椅；折叠帆布躺椅
短语：screen deck — [工程设计]筛板
例句：Let’s go up on deck .
我们到甲板上去吧。

congestion
音标：英 /kən'dʒestʃ(ə)n/  美 /kən'dʒɛstʃən/
n. 拥塞, 充血
短语：traffic congestion — 通信量拥挤；信号拥挤
短语：congestion control — 拥塞控制；拥挤控制
短语：congestion pricing — 拥挤收费；堵车费；高峰期行车收费
短语：nasal congestion — 鼻塞；鼻壅塞；鼻充血
短语：congestion avoidance — n. 拥塞避免
例句：The problems of traffic congestion will not disappear in a hurry.
交通堵塞问题不会很快消失。

engender
音标：英 /ɪn'dʒendə; en-/  美 /ɪn'dʒɛndɚ/
v. 造成
例句：In such circumstances, governments must do all they can to create and engender trust among its nation’s constituents and institutions.
在这种情况下，政府必须尽其所能在它的国家选民和公共机构之间创造和产生信任。
例句：Retrospectives on the process and working practices regularly capture the lessons learned by the project and engender a culture of continuous process improvement within the project.
对过程和工作实践的回顾有规律地捕捉从项目中得到的经验，并在项目中造成一个持续的过程改进的文化。

workplace
音标：英 /'wɜːkpleɪs/  美 /'wɝkples/
n. 工作场所
例句：...the difficulties facing women in the workplace.
…妇女在工作场所中面临的困难。

meticulous
音标：英 /mə'tɪkjələs/  美 /mə'tɪkjələs/
adj. 一丝不苟的, 缜密的
例句：He kept meticulous accounts.
他的账记得一丝不苟。
例句：Their planning and preparation were meticulous.
他们的计划和准备工作都很周密。
例句：He cleaned the tools with meticulous care.
他十分认真地清洁了工具。
例句：The book describes his journey in meticulous detail.
这本书很详细地描述了他的旅程。

fluent
音标：英 /'fluːənt/  美 /'fluənt/
adj. 流利的, 流畅的
短语：fluent english — 流利英语；英语流利
例句：He spoke in fluent Italian.
他用流利的意大利语讲话。

impermanence
n. 暂时, 无常
例句：So why then do we reject the impermanence of the ever-changing universe when it comes to our own lives?
所以，为什么我们要拒绝这千变万化的宇宙中的无常，当它来到我们身边时？
例句：During difficult times, be committed to resolving problems, but also lighten up and ride the waves of impermanence.
身处困境时，既要全神贯注地解决问题，也要身心放松，驾驭无常的世事。

impenetrable
音标：英 /ɪm'penɪtrəb(ə)l/  美 /ɪm'pɛnɪtrəbl/
adj. 不能穿过的, 不可理喻的
例句：The trees formed a dark and impenetrable barrier.
这些树形成了一道无法通过的黑暗屏障。
例句：the impenetrable blackness of the night
夜晚伸手不见五指的黑

expendable
音标：英 /ɪk'spendəb(ə)l; ek-/  美 /ɪk'spɛndəbl/
n. 消耗品, 可牺牲的
例句：You may be doing what could just as easily be done by someone else, which means you’re highly expendable. You may be playing follow the follower.
你可能在做一些其他也能轻易完成的事，那可能意味着你是完全可牺牲的，你可能是追随追随者的人。
例句：In the same way our bodies allocate blood flow away from expendable extremities in favour of vital organs during a crisis, companies must make sure their best markets and consumers are protected.
就像我们的身体在危急时刻，把血液从可以牺牲的四肢调配给致命器官的方式一样，公司必须确保其最好的市场和顾客受到保护。

undeniable
音标：英 /ʌndɪ'naɪəb(ə)l/  美 /'ʌndɪ'naɪəbl/
adj. 不可否认的, 无可辩驳的
例句：undeniable proof
确证

conqueror
音标：英 /'kɒŋk(ə)rə(r)/  美 /'kɑŋkərɚ/
n. 征服者, 胜利者
短语：william the conqueror — 征服者威廉（英国国王威廉一世，等于William I）
例句：The people of an oppressed country obey their conquerors because they want to go on living.
一个被压迫国家的人民顺从他们的征服者，是因为他们想活下去。

incur
音标：英 /ɪn'kɜː/  美 /ɪn'kɝ/
v. 招致
例句：The government had also incurred huge debts.
政府也已承受了大笔债务。

backbreaking
音标：英 /'bæk,breɪkɪŋ/  美 /'bæk,breikiŋ/
adj. 非常辛苦的,极累人的
例句：Just as our exchanges with the local grocer free us from backbreaking farm work, so do imports from around the world move us even more toward the very economic specialization that enriches us.
就好像我们与当地的杂货店交易，我们就不用非常辛苦地从事农业劳动，来自全世界的进口品让我们更快地走向经济专业化，使我们富裕。
